key_features: Mode fault error flag with CPU interrupt capability
Serial clock with programmable polarity and phase
Control of SPI operation during wait mode

release_history.change: Based on Barracuda; module changed from 16-bit to 8-bit.
Document template changed per Version 2.0 SRS.
Signal names changed per SRS2.0; SPE bit remains set in mode-fault error case; slave SPI does not support div2/div4.
Electrical spec added; SPIF cleared by read of status register followed by read of data register.
SPTEF bit clarified; landscape pages removed; blank pages removed.
Added document names; hidden variable definitions; chapter 3.9 Errata renamed Note.
Spec counter increased; config-bit change during master transmission aborts transmission and forces idle state.

CPHA=0 slave-mode transfer description changed; CPHA=1 master-mode transfer description changed; Figure 4-3 changed; mode-fault notes in bidirectional master mode; bidirectional mode with mode fault; stop mode last sentence.
Added note on max allowed baud rates; enhanced receive-buffer functionality; modified spi-slave wait/stop-mode note.

overview: The SPI module allows a duplex, synchronous, serial communication between the MCU and peripheral devices. Software can poll the SPI status flags or the SPI operation can be interrupt driven.
